headline: Khaitan India submits annual general meeting minutes
summary: Khaitan (India) Limited has submitted a copy of the minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on September 25, 2026, to the exchange. This is a standard regulatory compliance filing required for listed companies. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company can access the official proceedings through this submission. The filing contains procedural records rather than major financial developments.
why_it_matters: Procedural filing with no immediate impact on stock price
